name: Volumetric Sun Shafts (God Rays)
definition: A post-processing technique that renders volumetric light shafts (sun shafts) by marching a view ray through a sun shadow map, accumulating in-scattered light where the ray is lit and no light where it is shadowed, modulated by ground-hugging haze density.
summary: Volumetric Sun Shafts render light shafts by marching rays through a sun shadow map, differing from screen-space methods by using dedicated occlusion for geometry outside the view frustum.
